name: California Ground Squirrel
description: The California Ground Squirrel is a mottled gray-brown squirrel that uses burrows for shelter and protection. It occupies a variety of open habitats and woodland edges, often feeding close enough to retreat underground quickly. Seeds, nuts, fruits, and other available foods form its varied diet. Its bushy tail and upright alert posture can be conspicuous, but much of its daily activity takes place low to the ground as it moves between feeding spots and burrow entrances.
